snippet.title: Red Moon Kingdom - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
When a group of outcasts is sent to retrieve a wondrous artifact, a fatal mistake brings chaos upon the world. Explore, solve puzzles and card battle your way through a unique medieval fantasy setting full of magic with 3 controllable characters and in stunning 4K hand-drawn visuals.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3261520/Red_Moon_Kingdom/
